description: This file defines a 'ProductGrid' component for a LightningJS application. It manages layout properties, renders a grid of 'ProductCard' components based on a list of products, and contains methods for grid computations.

classes.name: ProductGrid
classes.description: A LightningJS component responsible for displaying a grid of product cards with specified layout and properties.

methods.name: $index
methods.description: Calculates the linear index of a product based on row and column.

methods.name: $productAt
methods.description: Retrieves the product at a specific row and column in the grid.

methods.name: $rowY
methods.description: Calculates the Y position of a row based on its index.

methods.name: $colX
methods.description: Calculates the X position of a column based on its index.
